media.alt: A small arrangement of pale pink garden roses and deep pink tulips with green foliage, in a low round glass vase on a white kitchen benchtop. A grey herringbone tile splashback and a red cookbook stand behind it; a gas cooktop fills the bottom right.

caption:
Your kitchen bench, every month, without you thinking about it.

A different design each time — we bring the new one and take the old one away. No water to change. Nothing wilting by Thursday.

Hand made, allergy-free, and good for five years.
